pratap-group.name: Pratap Group
pratap-group.logo: Light and dark SVG logos are on Drive.
pratap-group.imagery: Gradient at 90 degrees between green and azure.
pratap-group.about: Telecom, infrastructure and industrial group. The brand rules on this page start here.

telecrats.name: Telecrats India

colors.name: Telecrats Blue (working)
colors.role: Primary. Check against the master logo.

colors.name: Orange
colors.role: Accent in shapes only, one highlight per slide. Hex not set.

telecrats.logo: SVGs on Drive: navy one colour, reversed white, full colour.
telecrats.tagline: We keep India connected. (approved for a carousel closing slide)
telecrats.layout: Blue on white with lots of white.
telecrats.about: Telecom tower and optical fibre operations and maintenance, installation and commissioning, and solar-site upkeep. Serves operators, ISPs, government and SMBs.

beckhaul.name: Beckhaul Technologies
beckhaul.about: Optical fibre backhaul for operators and public networks, from rollout to making fibre earn.

corsis.name: Corsis Technologies
corsis.logo: Logo JPEG and CDR zip on Drive.
corsis.about: Optical fibre cables for telecom networks.

pals.name: PALS
pals.about: Pratap Academy of Learning Sciences. Training aimed at the telecom talent gap.

ductel.name: Ductel

colors.name: Teal
colors.role: Highlight. Never as text on white or Mist.

colors.name: Cyan
colors.role: Highlight. Never as text on white or Mist.

colors.name: Plum
colors.role: Highlight. Teal, cyan and plum together stay under about 15% of the canvas.

ductel.logo: Signature row: logo alone at left. Carousels add "Swipe" with triple chevron at right.
ductel.imagery: Clean isometric or flat technical illustration. No stock people. No text inside illustrations.
ductel.layout: 4:5, 1080x1350. Section label top left in slate caps, counter top right, headline under the label, illustration centre, supporting line, thin teal rule, signature row. Gradient only for highlight bars and the closing slide.
ductel.about: Protective ducts for fibre and power cables: PLB HDPE, microduct, aerial and tracer duct. Made in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh.

voltters.name: Voltters

colors.name: Voltters Teal
colors.role: Under about 10% of the canvas. Never as text on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Logo Teal
colors.role: Chevron mark only. Use the logo file.

colors.name: Mist White
colors.role: Text. Secondary text is Mist White at about 65% opacity.

voltters.imagery: Isometric 3D night scenes in the navy range. The lavender-to-violet storage panel look is not Voltters.
voltters.layout: Same 4:5 template as Ductel, with teal section label and rule.
voltters.about: EV battery packs, charge control units, EV chargers and battery energy storage. Made in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh.

rules.text: The signature is the company logo alone. Never write "a Pratap Group company".
Never alter the logo. Use only the official palette.

isometric-flat.name: Isometric / flat technical
isometric-flat.description: Clean isometric or flat technical illustration on a light background. No stock people. No text inside the illustration.
isometric-flat.bestFor: Explainers, process and product posts for ducts, cables, towers
dos: Flat fills with one soft shadow
isometric-flat.prompt: Clean isometric flat technical illustration of {subject}, light background, brand colours, soft shadow, no text, no people.

isometric-night.name: Isometric 3D night scene
isometric-night.description: Isometric 3D scenes in the navy range, lit like a night-time engineering blueprint. Avoid the lavender-to-violet panel look.
isometric-night.bestFor: Tech-forward posts: EV, energy storage, charging, network cores
isometric-night.prompt: Isometric 3D night scene of {subject}, deep navy palette, teal and cyan edge lighting, engineering blueprint feel, no text.

clean-white-minimal.name: Clean white minimal
clean-white-minimal.description: Brand blue on white with lots of empty space. Orange appears only in shapes, one highlight per slide.
clean-white-minimal.bestFor: Announcements, quotes, stats, hiring and culture posts
clean-white-minimal.prompt: Minimal layout on white, generous empty space, brand blue, one orange highlight shape, no decoration.

festival-3d.name: Festival 3D depth
festival-3d.description: For festival greetings: very little text, the logo colours plus one complementary accent, some 3D or depth. Must show what the company does and look different from other companies' creatives.
avoid: Generic diya and rangoli clip art
festival-3d.prompt: Festival greeting visual with soft 3D depth showing {subject} in the logo colours plus one complementary accent, very little text.

flat-vector-illustration.name: Flat vector illustration
flat-vector-illustration.description: Friendly flat vector scenes with simple shapes, no outlines, a limited palette of brand colours.
flat-vector-illustration.bestFor: Culture, training, safety and awareness posts
flat-vector-illustration.prompt: Flat vector illustration of {subject}, simple shapes, no outlines, limited brand palette, plenty of breathing room.

line-icon-infographic.name: Line icon infographic
line-icon-infographic.description: Thin consistent-stroke icons on a clean grid, numbered steps, short labels. Built for carousels that explain.
avoid: Paragraphs of text on a slide
line-icon-infographic.prompt: Infographic slide with thin line icons for {subject}, numbered steps, consistent stroke, brand colour accents, white background.

documentary-field-photo.name: Documentary field photography
documentary-field-photo.description: Real photography of real work on site: crews, towers, fibre, plants. Natural light, honest framing.
documentary-field-photo.bestFor: Proof posts, project updates, team and plant stories
documentary-field-photo.prompt: Documentary photograph of {subject}, natural light, candid, correct PPE, shallow depth of field.

duotone-photo.name: Brand duotone photo
duotone-photo.description: A photograph tinted into two brand colours so any company page looks unmistakably ours, with a clean text area.
dos: Two-colour tint from the brand palette
duotone-photo.prompt: Duotone treatment in {brand colours} on a photo of {subject}, high contrast, clear empty area for a headline.

3d-product-render.name: 3D product render
3d-product-render.description: Clean studio 3D render of one product, soft light, simple floor shadow, light or brand-colour backdrop.
3d-product-render.bestFor: Product launches: chargers, battery packs, cables, ducts
3d-product-render.prompt: Clean studio 3D render of {product}, soft light, subtle floor shadow, plain backdrop, accurate details.

blueprint-technical.name: Blueprint technical drawing
blueprint-technical.description: Engineering drawing look: fine lines, dimension marks, callouts, grid background. Shows how things are built.
blueprint-technical.prompt: Engineering blueprint style technical drawing of {subject}, white lines on deep blue grid, dimension marks and callouts.

cutaway-cross-section.name: Cutaway cross-section
cutaway-cross-section.description: A cut-open view that shows what is inside: duct layers, cable cores, battery packs, tower base.
cutaway-cross-section.bestFor: Explaining product construction and why quality matters
cutaway-cross-section.prompt: Cutaway cross-section illustration of {product} showing each internal layer, clean flat colours, labelled callouts.

network-topology-diagram.name: Network topology diagram
network-topology-diagram.description: Nodes and links drawn clearly: towers, fibre routes, rings, backhaul paths. Diagram first, decoration second.
network-topology-diagram.prompt: Clean network topology diagram of {subject}, nodes and links, colour coded by link type, light background.

data-viz-editorial.name: Data-led editorial
data-viz-editorial.description: One big number or chart carries the post. Plain background, annotated chart, source line.
data-viz-editorial.bestFor: Industry stats, market insight, thought leadership
data-viz-editorial.prompt: Editorial data visual about {stat}, one clear chart, big headline number, annotation, source line, clean palette.

bold-typography.name: Bold typographic poster
bold-typography.description: Type is the picture: huge headline, strong contrast, one supporting shape. Minimal imagery.
bold-typography.bestFor: Opinions, quotes, campaign taglines, event announcements
bold-typography.prompt: Typographic poster with the headline "{text}" set very large, strong contrast, one simple brand-colour shape, no photo.

gradient-abstract.name: Abstract gradient waves
gradient-abstract.description: Soft flowing gradients in the brand colours as a background for short statements.
gradient-abstract.prompt: Abstract flowing gradient waves in {brand colours}, soft and smooth, plenty of calm space for a headline.

neon-dark-tech.name: Dark tech glow
neon-dark-tech.description: Near-black background with thin glowing lines and data motifs. For future-facing technology topics.
neon-dark-tech.prompt: Dark futuristic tech visual of {subject}, near-black background, thin glowing lines in {accent colour}, subtle grid.

paper-cut-layered.name: Layered paper-cut
paper-cut-layered.description: Stacked paper-like layers with soft shadows creating depth. Warm and handmade.
paper-cut-layered.prompt: Layered paper-cut illustration of {subject}, 4 layers, soft shadows, brand palette plus one warm accent.

clay-3d-friendly.name: Friendly 3D clay
clay-3d-friendly.description: Soft rounded clay-like 3D objects with gentle light. Approachable and playful.
clay-3d-friendly.bestFor: Academy and learning (PALS), awareness, explainers for non-experts
clay-3d-friendly.prompt: Friendly soft 3D clay style scene of {subject}, rounded shapes, gentle lighting, brand colours.

hand-drawn-sketch.name: Hand-drawn sketch
hand-drawn-sketch.description: Marker or pen sketch on a plain background: whiteboard explanation feel, human and informal.
hand-drawn-sketch.bestFor: Teaching, Q and A, behind-the-scenes ideas
hand-drawn-sketch.prompt: Hand-drawn marker sketch explaining {subject}, whiteboard style, one brand highlight colour, simple labels.

pattern-geometric.name: Geometric pattern graphic
pattern-geometric.description: Repeating geometric shapes derived from the logo or product (ducts, fibre strands, hexagons) as a texture.
pattern-geometric.bestFor: Backgrounds, banners, event branding, pages and covers
dos: Derive shapes from the product or logo
Low contrast so text sits on top
pattern-geometric.prompt: Subtle geometric pattern built from {motif}, brand colours, low contrast, tileable.
